engineeringAssessment.postGetConsistency: Same newly created object should receive consistent interpretation through existing output(id) function; this is implementation coherence, not a new product policy.
engineeringAssessment.flush: Synchronizes pending SQL within existing transaction. It does not imply commit. Must prove subsequent audit failure rolls object and audit back together.
